title: A quarter of deploys, overlaid
description: each wedge = one deploy · angle = time of day · reach = files touched · ink builds where deploys pile up

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered deployments with hour in [0,24), angular window in [0,360] degrees, finite nonnegative files touched and incident status. The original absolute radius is files/6 with a 96-file inner hole; zero-width windows and reaches inside the hole produce no annular ink. Incomplete observations remain unavailable.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
